Maya: Heads-up: deploy-bot failed promoting canary -> prod. Cut window in 25m.
Maya: CI jobs failing at artifact unpack step with permission errors creating symlinks.
Liam: Failing log:
```
+ tar -xzf artifacts.tgz
tar: bin/link -> ../bin: Cannot create symlink
ERROR: extraction failed
```
ops-jen: Oncall. Confirmed cache host kernel update earlier. Reverting kernels during window risky (~20m).
ops-jen: Recommend pin to last-green and manual promote to meet SLA.
Maya: If we pin, need release note and infra ticket. Who can run manual promote?
Liam: I can. Promote command:
```
/deploy promote --image sha:d4e9c1 --env prod --reason "pin-cache-unpack-perm-fail"
```
deploy-bot: Manual promotion requested by Liam. Awaiting operator confirmation.
Liam: Running now. /deploy promote --image sha:d4e9c1 --env prod --reason "pin-cache-unpack-perm-fail"
deploy-bot: Promotion started -> health checks OK -> promotion complete. prod image sha:d4e9c1.
QA-Bot: Queued quick smoke: uploads/auth/search. Will report in 8m.
Maya: Thanks. Liam please add release note: pinned sha:d4e9c1 due to CI artifact extraction permission errors; infra ticket INFRA-2035 opened.
ops-jen: INFRA-2035 created with logs and failing job ids bk/3123,bk/3128. Follow-up out of band.
Maya: Closing thread, follow-ups tracked.
__notes: Slack thread string. Messages chronological and prefixed with sender name.
